parts:
Dear Sir/Madam,
I, Steven Rathmann, a new user of Deducer (An
R Graphical User Interface (GUI) for Everyone) am facing some
problems. I successfully installed in my system using RGui in XP
Service pack 3. When I did "Merge two data files into one based on a
common identifier." with the given data, it shows the result as
"Merged Data Name". When I double clicked the
“demographics.visit.merged”, the DataTable has been displayed. The
result is attached with this mail. But when I want to use "Save As"
option to save the “demographics.visit.merged” result with my
preferred extension like .csv, .xls etc. I could not find it.
DataTable: File => Save As => Files of type (All Files). How can I
save the result with my preferred extension like .csv, .xls etc.?
I will obliged to you, if you kindly help me to resolve the problem.
Thanking you,
Steven

messages.subject: Re: Urgent Query

http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.SaveData

csv is supported, but not xls
